distribution.narrative: Accepted for Taiwan from Beaver & Liu (2010). The source treats Coriacephilus coriaceus as a first Taiwan record and reports specimens from Nantou (Huison and Neimoupu). Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown; no confirmed host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coriacephilus coriaceus (Eichhoff, 1878).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Coriacephilus coriaceus (Eichhoff, 1878), VSN_1390. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Coriacephilus coriaceus with authorship (Eichhoff).
